items.distractor_fact: Qo'shni tumandagi stansiya o'sha kuni ertalab {D}°C haroratni qayd etdi.
items.gloss_en: The station in the neighboring district recorded a temperature of {D}°C that morning.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different weather station in a neighboring district, not the thermometer in the story

items.distractor_fact: Boshqa kompaniyaning aksiyasi o'sha kuni {D} dollar narxda savdo qilindi.
items.gloss_en: Another company's stock traded at {D} dollars that day.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different company's stock, not the one whose price is being compared

items.distractor_fact: Qo'shni ko'lning suv sathi o'sha kuni {D} santimetrni tashkil etdi.
items.gloss_en: The neighboring lake's water level that day came to {D} centimetres.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different, neighboring lake, not the lake in the question

items.distractor_fact: Osmonda o'sha paytda uchgan boshqa uchar apparat {D} metr balandlikda edi.
items.gloss_en: Another aircraft flying in the sky at that time was at an altitude of {D} metres.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different aircraft in the sky, not the one whose altitude is compared

items.distractor_fact: Navbatdagi bemorning vazni {D} kilogrammni tashkil etdi.
items.gloss_en: The next patient's weight came to {D} kilograms.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different patient, not the one whose weight change is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Qo'shni qishloqning aholisi o'sha yili {D} kishini tashkil etdi.
items.gloss_en: The neighboring village's population that year came to {D} people.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different, neighboring village, not the village in the question

items.distractor_fact: Yo'ldagi boshqa mashinaning tezligi o'sha paytda {D} km/soat edi.
items.gloss_en: Another car on the road had a speed of {D} km/h at that moment.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different car on the road, not the one whose speed is compared

items.gloss_en: Another customer's account currently held a balance of {D} dollars.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different customer's account, not the account whose balance is computed

items.gloss_en: Another department's expense that month came to {D} dollars.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different department, not the one whose income and expenses are compared

items.distractor_fact: Boshqa jamoa o'sha mavsumda {D} ta gol urdi.
items.gloss_en: Another team scored {D} goals that season.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different team's season tally, not the team in the question

items.gloss_en: A golfer who played on a different course finished this round with {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different golfer on a different course whose par is not stated, so the story's own par cannot be applied to it

items.gloss_en: A train on a different route arrived at the station that day at minute {D} after midnight.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different train on a different route with its own unstated timetable, not the train and schedule in the question

items.distractor_fact: Uchinchi jamoa o'sha kuni boshqa o'yinda {D} ta gol urdi.
items.gloss_en: A third team scored {D} goals in a different match that day.
items.entity_note: belongs to a third team in a different match, not either of the two teams the question compares
